categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in semiconductor specialized equipment, focusing on four main business segments: front-end coating and developing equipment, front-end cleaning equipment, back-end advanced packaging equipment, and compound semiconductor small-size equipment. These products cover front-end wafer processing, back-end advanced packaging, and compound semiconductor fields.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include advanced coating and developing processes tightly integrated with lithography machines, high-capacity and high-precision equipment architectures, precise environmental control, and innovative cleaning technologies such as high-temperature SPM chemical cleaning. The company also develops temporary bonding and debonding equipment for 2.5D/3D advanced packaging and SiC wafer dicing equipment using proprietary SnB dicing technology. Manufacturing involves high integration, multi-module coordination, and rigorous quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading domestic and international semiconductor manufacturers in logic, memory, power devices, and advanced packaging sectors, including TSMC, SMIC, Hua Tian Technology, and others. The company serves semiconductor wafer fabs and packaging and testing companies, addressing markets in front-end wafer processing, back-end packaging, and compound semiconductor device manufacturing.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Shenyang and Shanghai, and subsidiaries in Guangzhou and Japan. Its sales and service network covers major semiconductor industry clusters in the Yangtze River Delta, Pearl River Delta, and Taiwan. The Japanese subsidiary supports supply chain and new product development.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the upstream to midstream segment of the semiconductor equipment supply chain, providing critical manufacturing equipment for wafer processing and packaging. It also engages in core component development, aiming for an integrated machine plus parts supply model.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening front-end coating and developing equipment, expanding into chemical cleaning and advanced packaging equipment, and developing compound semiconductor equipment. The company emphasizes high R&D investment (16.92% of revenue), innovation in inline high-capacity equipment, chemical cleaning technologies, temporary bonding/debonding solutions, and SiC dicing. It pursues localization to break foreign monopolies and enhance competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of semiconductor specialized equipment, including coating and developing machines, wet process equipment, and new product lines. Additional income comes from sales of related parts and after-sales services. The company mainly uses a direct sales model supported by technical and service teams.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a domestic leader in coating and developing equipment and single-wafer wet process equipment, successfully breaking foreign monopolies in several segments. It competes with global giants like ASML, TEL, and DNS in high-end equipment but has established a strong foothold in the Chinese market with growing international recognition, especially in advanced packaging.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 1.75 billion, a 2.13% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 203 million, down 19.08%. Total assets reached RMB 5.6 billion, up 30.11%, and net assets RMB 2.69 billion, up 13.05%. R&D expenses increased by nearly 50%, reflecting a growth-oriented investment strategy. The company has expanded its workforce to 1,366 employees, with over 33% in R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers domestically produced, high-performance semiconductor equipment with international-level technology, focusing on breaking foreign monopolies in critical front-end coating and cleaning equipment. Its products feature high stability, precision, and integration, with strong customer recognition for cost-effectiveness and localized support. The company emphasizes comprehensive product lines covering front-end to back-end processes and continuous innovation in emerging fields like Chiplet packaging and SiC wafer processing.
